🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive — broad strength. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -2.44% | 1M: -16.31%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling (fear easing) and SPY/TLT (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +1.83%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; note HYG/LQD shows credit stress rising (HYG (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND / LQD (1W: -0.29% | 1M: -0.06%) BELOW TREND) as a downside risk.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stress EDGE: HYG/LQD reading (Level: 0.7323 | 1W: +0.41% | 1M: +0.62%) ↑ rising signals tightening credit conditions. Fear decreasing: VXX (1W: -2.44% | 1M: -16.31%) BELOW TREND; reflation/materials push from CPER (1W: +9.04% | 1M: +13.49%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-supportive: UUP (1W: +0.67% | 1M: -0.08%) RECOVERY with Dollar modestly firm, while TLT (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -1.08%) BELOW TREND reflects higher yields; yield curve (Level: 1.0528) → flat BELOW TREND.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Materials/Industrials leading: XLB (1W: +3.85% | 1M: +7.94%) ABOVE TREND and XME (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +14.25%) ABOVE TREND; Tech mixed — XLK (1W: +0.53% | 1M: +0.92%) ABOVE TREND while Tech vs Financials ratio is falling (Tech losing relative edge). Style: Value/cyclicals showing strength vs Growth.

5. US vs Global?  
US still firm: SPY (1W: +0.58% | 1M: +1.38%) ABOVE TREND, but EM leadership accelerating — EEM (1W: +4.79% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +2.63%) ABOVE TREND show regional outperformance.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation recovering: IWM (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +2.03%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +6.22% | 1M: -0.11%) RECOVERY indicate risk-on positioning; ARKK (1W: +4.13% | 1M: -0.96%) RECOVERY shows short-term bounce in high-beta innovation exposure.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Broad commodity rebound led by metals: SLV (1W: +11.66% | 1M: +42.41%) ABOVE TREND, PPLT (1W: +14.35% | 1M: +46.77%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +9.04% | 1M: +13.49%) ABOVE TREND — reflation bias intact. Gold supportive: GLD (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +6.73%) ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?  
Mixed: XLE (1W: +2.29% | 1M: -0.18%) RECOVERY while Brent (BNO (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -3.70%)) BELOW TREND; natural gas UNG (1W: -13.56% | 1M: -27.97%) BELOW TREND remains a clear weakness.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Breadth (9/11), VXX falling and SPY/TLT rising support RISK-ON. DIVERGENCE: credit spread (HYG/LQD) rising and several RECOVERY signals (IBIT, ARKK, XLE)—overall MINOR divergence, not a regime breaker.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor cyclicals/materials exposure (XLB, XME, XLI/ITA) and EM (EEM, FXI) showing strength; reduce exposure to defensive staples and communications (XLP, XLC) which are showing weakness, and monitor credit stress metrics and TLT for rate-driven shifts.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Materials — XLB (1W: +3.85% | 1M: +7.94%) ABOVE TREND; Semis/Industrials — SOXX (1W: +7.54% | 1M: +7.36%) ABOVE TREND and ITA (1W: +6.09% | 1M: +12.48%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Communications — XLC (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -0.13%) BELOW TREND; Staples — XLP (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -1.48%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Copper/Industrial metals — CPER (1W: +9.04% | 1M: +13.49%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +11.66% | 1M: +42.41%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -13.56% | 1M: -27.97%) BELOW TREND and oil proxies BNO (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -3.70%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~26 (VXX (1W: -2.44% | 1M: -16.31%) BELOW TREND) as a watch for complacency; HYG/LQD ~0.73 (credit health) — rising is a risk; Tech vs Financials ratio ~2.60 (Tech losing relative footing); SPY/TLT ~7.93 (stocks vs bonds) as a risk-on threshold.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive with VXX falling and SPY/TLT ↑ rising confirming broad risk appetite. Materials, industrials and EM (XLB, XME, EEM, FXI) are showing relative strength while Tech is mixed. Key risk: rising credit stress (HYG/LQD) and pockets of RECOVERY-driven divergence (IBIT/ARKK/XLE) to monitor.
